name: American-Iowa Manufacturing Inc.
old_description: for the golf and turf maintenance industry since 1989. A.I.M. is proud
about:
Founded in 1989 in Cascade, Iowa, American-Iowa Manufacturing Inc. (A.I.M.) began as a supplier to the golf and turf maintenance industry. The company operates from a 74,200-square-foot facility that includes 4,200 square feet of office and engineering space.

A.I.M. provides metal fabrication, welding, powder coating, assembly, and packaging services under one roof. Its semi-automated powder coat system features one of the largest part windows in Iowa, accommodating parts up to 5 feet by 7 feet by 9 feet (expandable to 6.5 by 12 feet) and 400 pounds per hook. A PLC central control system manages batch-specific parameters, and the welding department supports custom fabrication. The shop employs over 25 full-time workers plus a management team.

The primary market is the golf and turf maintenance sector, where A.I.M. produces components such as mower decks, rollers, and other turf-care equipment. The company also accepts outsourcing work from other manufacturers needing fabrication-to-finish capabilities.

A.I.M. emphasizes its full-line manufacturing model, which lets customers consolidate fabrication, finishing, and assembly with a single source. The firm states that this approach delivers the highest quality product at a competitive price.
